verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a broad, versioned REST API covering contacts, custom objects, webhooks and account details, with per-endpoint OpenAPI specs. Its MCP server also gives agents read/write access to CRM data such as contacts, deals and engagements. However, many UI features in the pack (workflows, sequences, reports and dashboards, imports, deduplication, connected email) are documented only as UI knowledge-base procedures, with no corresponding API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API evidence for workflows, sequences, reporting/dashboards, imports and deduplication, and independent corroboration of coverage.
